state.project: Adamsville - Buzzard Roost 230kV Rebuild And Jumper Upgrade
state.description: Rebuild the line sections from Adamsville to Boat Rock Road (8.08 miles) on the Adamsville - Buzzard Roost 230kV line with 200C 1351 ACSS Martin conductor. Replace the AAC 750 jumper on the line at Adamsville with (2) 1590 AAC jumper. Replace 1590 AAC jumpers at Bakers Ferry and Boat Rock with (2) 1590 AAC jumpers. Replace 1600A line switches at Boat Rock with 3000A switches.
